exception.FIRST_CANDIDATE: No trial needed: the baseline set as the first candidate set.

check.NO_ASSUMED_CARRIER_ROW: No carrier mode on while a contract row it would use is assumed

why.TRIAL_SET: The set holds a what-if on planner data: it is a trial set, never the candidate set.
why.CARRIER_ROW_ASSUMED: A carrier mode is on while a contract row it would use is assumed.
why.NO_TRIAL: No kept trial ran on this version.
why.TRIAL_TOO_SHORT: The trial covers fewer than 14 whole days.
why.TRIAL_TOO_OLD: The trial ended more than 7 days ago.
why.TRIAL_REFUSED_TOO_MANY: The trial refused more than 5% of its orders.
why.TRIAL_STOP_FINDING: The trial holds a stop finding.
why.TRIAL_NOT_PLAN_CHECKED: The nightly plan check has not read the trial yet.
why.REASON_SILENT_ON_FIGURE: The reason does not name every "too few" or "not steady" figure.
why.unknown: Refused for a reason this screen does not know:

refusal.MODE_SWITCHED_ON: A mode switched on that the run did not read
refusal.REACH_WIDER_THAN_READ: A reach wider than was read
refusal.STORE_ADDED_TO_MODE: A store added to a mode
refusal.LONGER_WAITING_CAP: A longer cap on a waiting delivery's age
refusal.HIGHER_PAIR_CAP_ON_CUT_RUN: A higher pair cap on a run whose pairs were cut
refusal.STORE_NEVER_READ: A store the run never read
refusal.PRODUCT_RULE_SWITCHED_ON: A product rule row switched on
